answer.summary: Stilt Hollow is a medium witch village of ten raised buildings: the coven mother's hut, four witch huts, a brewing house, an herb shed, a coven circle platform, a boathouse and a watch perch. Rope bridges link them. Raised-on-stilts building isn't available yet, so the zone and its bridges wait. The land isn't surveyed, so the plan assumes swamp water nearby and names none.
